'''Fend'Allomin''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] for the vast majority of her life. At some point during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of her adult life, Fend'Allomin was rescued from slavery by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vhiin Thorla]] and taken to the hidden settlement known as [[The Enclave]], with several others of her kind.
